_about: WS-DATA seed (brief §4.5, §4.0 mega-menu, §4.1 §3 tiles, §4.7 verticals). Text fields are templates (CONTRACT.md Data §D2): no £ or date literals. Edits via INTEGRATION.md only.

collections.name: Custom neon signs
collections.h1: Custom neon signs, made in the UK
collections.intro: Type your words and watch them light up on a real-looking wall, priced as you go. We draw a proof for you to approve before a single tube is bent.

sizeGuide.text: Most text signs land between 60 and 120 cm wide.

tile.line: Type anything, see it lit and priced in seconds.

collections.metaTitle: Custom neon signs, made in the UK | Lit Neon
collections.metaDescription: Design a custom LED neon sign online: live price, a proof drawing before we make it, and free delivery across mainland GB.

collections.name: Name signs
collections.intro: Your surname over the sofa, a baby's name above the cot, your initials where the wedding photos go. Type any name and we'll draw it up for you to approve before we make it.

sizeGuide.text: Above a sofa, 80 to 120 cm reads best.

tile.line: Surnames, first names and initials, drawn to order.

collections.metaTitle: Personalised neon name signs | Lit Neon
collections.metaDescription: Personalised LED neon name signs for homes, nurseries and weddings. Type any name, approve the drawing, free mainland-GB delivery.

collections.name: Bedroom
collections.intro: A soft glow for the wall above the bed, and an optional dimmer and remote so it never outshines the reading lamp. Pick a phrase below or write your own.

sizeGuide.text: Above a double bed, 80 to 100 cm reads best.

tile.line: Soft light above the bed, dimmable from the pillow.

collections.metaTitle: Neon signs for the bedroom | Lit Neon
collections.metaDescription: LED neon bedroom signs with an optional dimmer and remote. Ready-made phrases or your own words, made in a UK workshop.

collections.name: Home bar
collections.intro: Every good bar needs a name in lights, even if it's a shelf in the kitchen. Choose a classic or put your own house rules in tube.

sizeGuide.text: Above a back bar or shelf, 60 to 90 cm reads best.

tile.line: A name in lights for the bar, the shed or the shelf.

collections.metaTitle: Home bar and pub neon signs | Lit Neon
collections.metaDescription: LED neon bar signs for home bars, sheds and pubs. Classic phrases or your bar's own name, made in the UK.

collections.name: Wedding
collections.intro: Your names, your date or the line you'll say on the day, lit above the top table. After the honeymoon it moves to the hallway, which is more than can be said for the centrepieces.

sizeGuide.text: Above a top table, 100 to 120 cm; a full backdrop takes 150 to 200 cm.

tile.line: Top tables, backdrops, then the hallway for good.

collections.metaDescription: Wedding LED neon signs with your names or vows: a proof drawing first, made in a UK workshop, yours to keep after the day.

collections.name: Kitchen & hallway
collections.intro: The kitchen is where everyone ends up, so give it something to read. Warm white suits the morning; colour suits the party.

sizeGuide.text: Above the units or a doorway, 50 to 80 cm reads best.

tile.line: House rules for the room where everyone ends up.

collections.metaTitle: Neon signs for the kitchen and hallway | Lit Neon
collections.metaDescription: LED neon kitchen signs: cuppa-first classics or your own words, made in the UK, with an optional dimmer and remote.

collections.name: Gaming
collections.intro: Something bright above the monitor that isn't the low-battery warning. Colour-changing tubes with a remote let you match the game, the team or the mood.

sizeGuide.text: Above a desk or monitor, 60 to 90 cm reads best.

tile.line: Static or colour changing, above the monitor.

collections.metaTitle: Gaming room neon signs | Lit Neon
collections.metaDescription: LED neon gaming signs in static or colour-changing tube, with an optional dimmer and remote. Your gamertag or ours, made in the UK.

collections.name: Business
collections.intro: Logo signs, open signs and back-bar names, drawn by a designer from your artwork. Free mockup and price within {value:mockupHours} hours.

sizeGuide.text: Behind a counter, 80 to 150 cm reads best.

tile.line: Logos, open signs and counter signs, drawn by a person.

collections.metaTitle: Neon signs for business | Lit Neon
collections.metaDescription: LED neon logo and business signs drawn from your artwork, with a free mockup and price before you commit.

collections.name: Wall art
collections.intro: Hearts, moons and lightning bolts drawn as a single line of tube. No words needed, just a bit of wall.

sizeGuide.text: On a feature wall, 40 to 70 cm reads best.

tile.line: Line-art icons and one-word signs for any wall.

collections.metaDescription: LED neon wall art: hearts, moons, lightning bolts and one-word signs, drawn as tube and made in a UK workshop.

collections.name: Kids & nursery
collections.intro: A name above the cot or a night light with a bit of personality. Dim it right down at bedtime with the optional dimmer and remote.

sizeGuide.text: Above a cot or toddler bed, 50 to 70 cm reads best.

tile.line: Nursery names and night lights, dimmable at bedtime.

collections.metaTitle: Kids and nursery neon signs | Lit Neon
collections.metaDescription: LED neon signs for nurseries and kids' rooms: names, night lights and new-baby gifts, with an optional dimmer and remote.

collections.name: Christmas
collections.intro: A festive sign that outlasts the tinsel and doesn't need untangling. Every sign is made to order once you've approved its drawing, so give yourself time.

sizeGuide.text: Above a mantelpiece, 60 to 90 cm reads best.

tile.line: The decoration that never needs untangling.

collections.metaDescription: Christmas LED neon signs made to order in a UK workshop, with free mainland-GB delivery.

collections.name: Halloween
collections.intro: Spooky season, lit properly. Orange, violet and green tubes that do the work of a dozen pumpkins and never go soft.

sizeGuide.text: In a window or above a door, 40 to 70 cm reads best.

tile.line: Orange, violet and green, for the door and the bar cart.

collections.metaDescription: Halloween LED neon signs in orange, violet and green, made to order in a UK workshop.
